sample_unit: lay abstracts and summaries generated from 25 oncology abstracts

links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI-generated lay summaries, task-specific tool versus general-purpose LLMs
links.effect: General-purpose LLMs produced FKGL 9.6-13.4 and SMOG 7.6-11.2, well above plain-language levels. Pub2Post produced FKGL 5.2 and SMOG 4.4, with FRES 82.3 versus 38.0-61.6 for the LLMs.
links.quote: The general-purpose LLMs generated shorter, denser outputs (4-9 sentences; 81-156 words) with higher grade-levels (FRES 38.0-61.6; FKGL 9.6-13.4; GFS 10.6-15.9; SI 7.6-11.2; CLI 13.4-17.0; ARI 11.0-15.2).

links.outcome: Consistency of readability outputs across repeated generations within each model
links.effect: All platforms showed consistent intra-model outputs across triplicate generations (all P > .05).
links.quote: All the platforms demonstrated consistent intra-model outputs across triplicate generations (all P > .05).

unlisted_practices: Using a purpose-built task-specific LLM tool instead of general-purpose LLMs to generate readable lay summaries of research

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the effect of prompting strategies (specific vs generic) and a task-specific tool on readability metrics of oncology research summaries for lay audiences.

primary.practice: prompting strategies and task-specific tooling for readability
